company_summary.one_line_business: Supermicro 為資料中心、雲端與邊緣運算設計並供應應用最佳化伺服器、儲存、機架級及液冷系統。

ai_exposure.summary: Supermicro 供應 AI 訓練與推論使用的高密度 GPU 伺服器、機架級系統及液冷設備。

company_summary.one_line_business.value: Supermicro designs and supplies application-optimized server, storage, rack-scale and liquid-cooling systems for data centers, cloud and edge computing.

value.summary: Supermicro supplies high-density GPU servers, rack-scale systems and liquid cooling for AI training and inference.
